y-m-02-03.title: Incwadi yesi-3 kusuka kwesobunxele, iyiphi indawo kusuka kwesokudla?
y-m-02-03.topic: Indawo nokuhleleka: ukusho indawo ngokuya ngereferensi
y-m-02-03.goal: Sho indawo efanayo ngenombolo ebaliwe kusuka kwesobunxele nenombolo ebaliwe kusuka kwesokudla, thola iphethini phakathi kwezinombolo ezimbili, yenza izindawo ezimbalwa ezingenzeka, futhi uthole amacala lapho ulwazi lungekho.
y-m-02-03.material: Izincwadi ezingu-7 zimi emgqeni ocaleni lweshelufu elilodwa lebhukhukheyisi. Kwesobunxele nokwesokudla yilokho okubonwa umi phambi kwebhukhukheyisi. Izincwadi zisemgqeni oqhubekayo ongenazikhala. UMina wabala incwadi eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kusuka kwesobunxele futhi wathi 'yesi-2', noSeohyeon wabala kusuka kwesokudla futhi wathi 'yesi-6'. Bobabili babale kahle.
y-m-02-03.thinking.0: Ukwazi ukuthi uma ireferensi ishintsha, amagama okubiza into efanayo nawo ashintsha
y-m-02-03.prereq.1: Amagama abonisa ukulandelana afana nokuqala, okwesibili, nokwesithathu
y-m-02-03.s.s1.prompt: Ingabe izincwadi uMina noSeohyeon abakhuluma ngazo zingaba yincwadi efanayo?
y-m-02-03.s.s1.hint.0: Dweba izincwadi ezingu-7 njengezindingilizi ezingu-7 bese ubhala izinombolo 1, 2, 3, ... kusukela ngakwesobunxele.
y-m-02-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ezindingilizini ezifanayo, bhala nezinombolo ezibaliwe kusukela ngakwesokudla bese uthola indawo yesibili.
y-m-02-03.s.s1.o.a: Ziyizincwadi ezihlukile. Okwesibili nokwesithupha kuyizindawo ezihlukile
y-m-02-03.s.s1.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi izinombolo ezibaliwe ezihlukile zisho izindawo ezihlukile. Ingabe ucabange ukuthi umugqa ubalwa kusukela ohlangothini luni?
y-m-02-03.s.s1.o.b: Zingaba yincwadi efanayo. Bazibale bevela ezinhlangothini eziphambene
y-m-02-03.s.s1.r.b: Lo mbono wukuthi uma uhlangothi obala kusuka kulo luhlukile, incwadi efanayo ingathola inombolo ehlukile.
y-m-02-03.s.s1.o.c: Awukwazi ukusho. Ngoba awazi ukuthi zingaki izincwadi
y-m-02-03.s.s1.r.c: Ushiye ulwazi lokuthi kunezincwadi ezingu-7. Bheka ukuthi ulwazi oludingekayo selukhona kulesi simo yini.
y-m-02-03.s.s1.explain: Uma umugqa unezincwadi ezingu-7, kunezincwadi ezingu-5 ngakwesokudla sencwadi yesibili kusukela ngakwesobunxele. Ibhekwa kusukela ngakwesokudla, leyo ncwadi inezincwadi ezingu-5 phambi kwayo, ngakho iyesithupha. Izinombolo zihlukile kuphela ngoba uhlangothi obala kusuka kulo luhlukile; iyincwadi efanayo.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.prompt: Incwadi ebomvu isesishelufini sezincwadi esifanayo (izincwadi ezingu-7). Yenza izindawo ezi-2 ezihlukile ukuze incwadi ebomvu ibe ngakwesobunxele sendawo ephakathi (yesine). Bhala ku-a indawo kusukela ngakwesobunxele futhi ku-b indawo kusukela ngakwesokudla. Izinombolo ezimbili kufanele zikhombe incwadi eyodwa efanayo.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala inombolo ebaliwe kusukela ngakwesobunxele nenombolo ebaliwe kusukela ngakwesokudla ndawonye emgqeni wezindingilizi ezingu-7.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.hint.1: Qala ubale ukuthi zingaki izindawo ezisengakwesobunxele sendawo ephakathi (yesine).
y-m-02-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Inombolo ebaliwe kusukela ngakwesobunxele iyinombolo kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-7.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Inombolo ebaliwe kusukela ngakwesobunxele kufanele ibe yinombolo yemvelo kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-7.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Inombolo ebaliwe kusukela ngakwesokudla iyinombolo kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-7.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Inombolo ebaliwe kusukela ngakwesokudla kufanele ibe yinombolo yemvelo kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-7.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Izinombolo ezimbili zikhomba incwadi eyodwa efanayo.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Lezi zinombolo ezimbili azikhombi incwadi efanayo. Bhala izinombolo emgqeni wezincwadi ezingu-7 bese uhlola.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.explain: Izindawo ezingenzeka zintathu: (1,7), (2,6), ne-(3,5). Indawo yesine iyesine kusukela ngakwesobunxele futhi neyesine kusukela ngakwesokudla, ngakho ayikho 'ngakwesobunxele sendawo ephakathi'.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Bhala, usebenzisa izinombolo, ukuthi b inqunywa kanjani uma a isinqunyiwe, okungukuthi, iphethini oyitholile phakathi kwezinombolo ezimbili.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bhala izinombolo ezimbili zezindawo ezimbili owazenza eceleni komunye nomunye bese uqhathanisa ukuthi zihlobene kanjani.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi kwenzekani enombolweni yesokudla uma inombolo yesobunxele inyuka ngoyedwa.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.placeholder: Isibonelo: Uma ingowe-...th kusukela ngakwesobunxele, ingowe-...th kusukela ngakwesokudla.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe iphethini oyibhale ilungile kokubili noma ezindaweni eziningi ozenzile?
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale uyazi ukuthi iphethini isetshenziswa kuphela uma kunezincwadi ezingu-7?
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Uma ingeyesi-3 kusukela ngakwesobunxele, ingeyesi-5 kusukela ngakwesokudla. Uma wengeza izinombolo ezimbili, ihlala ingu-8.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Njalo uma inombolo yesobunxele inyuka ngo-1, inombolo yesokudla yehla ngo-1. Njengowe-1 nowesi-7, owesi-2 nowesi-6.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Kushiwo ngokuthi ishintsha kanjani ngaphandle kokusebenzisa isamba. Lokhu nakho kuvumelekile.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.prompt: Kwesinye isishelufu sezincwadi, awazi ukuthi zingaki izincwadi. Utshelwe kuphela ukuthi incwadi eluhlaza iyesithathu kusukela ngakwesobunxele. Ungasho ukuthi leyo ncwadi iyiphi indawo kusukela ngakwesokudla?
y-m-02-03.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga ukubeka enye incwadi ekugcineni kwesokudla bese ubheka ukuthi ukulandelana kwencwadi eluhlaza kusukela ngakwesobunxele kuyashintsha yini.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.hint.1: Dweba icala lezincwadi ezingu-5 nelicala lezincwadi ezingu-7 bese uqhathanisa ukuthi iyiphi indawo kusukela ngakwesokudla.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.o.a: Ungasho kuphela uma uyazi ukuthi zingaki izincwadi sekuyonke
y-m-02-03.s.s3.r.a: Uhlolile ukuthi ulwazi lwanele yini futhi washo ukuthi yini enganele.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.o.b: Cabanga ukuthi esinye isishelufu sezincwadi nasona sinezincwadi ezingu-7 bese uthi iyesi-5 kusukela ngakwesokudla
y-m-02-03.s.s3.r.b: Udlulisele ulwazi lokuthi isishelufu sangaphambilini sasinezincwadi ezingu-7 ngqo kulesi sishelufu. Kakutshelwanga ukuthi lesi sishelufu sinezincwadi ezingaki.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.r.c: Usebenzise inombolo ebaliwe kusukela ngakwesobunxele ngendlela efanayo ngakwesokudla. Cabanga ukuthi kwenzekani uma kungeyona incwadi ephakathi.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.o.d: Noma ngabe zingaki izincwadi, indawo kusukela ngakwesokudla inqunyiwe
y-m-02-03.s.s3.r.d: Ucabange ukuthi inombolo ihlala injalo noma izincwadi ziyanda. Cabanga ukuthi kwenzekani uma ubeka enye incwadi ngakwesokudla.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.explain: Uma wazi kuphela ukuthi iyesithathu kusukela ngakwesobunxele, awukwazi ukusho ukuthi zingaki izincwadi ezisengakwesokudla sayo. Uma kunezincwadi ezingu-5, iyesithathu kusukela ngakwesokudla, futhi uma kunezincwadi ezingu-7, iyesi-5 kusukela ngakwesokudla. Ungakwazi ukunquma kuphela uma uyazi ukuthi zingaki izincwadi sekuyonke.

y-m-02-05.title: Uma uphawu lokugcina lukhulu, ingabe lude?
y-m-02-05.goal: Qonda ukuthi ulwazi mayelana nesiphetho esisodwa kuphela alwanele ukuqhathanisa ubude, sho ukuthi udinga nokwazi ukuthi ngamunye uqala kuphi, lungisa isinqumo sakho sokuqala ngolwazi olusha, bese ukhetha indlela yokuqhathanisa ngqo.
y-m-02-05.material: Etafuleni, ipensela 가 nepensela 나 zilele ziqondile eceleni komunye nomunye eduze kwe-ruler. I-ruler inamamaki kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-10, futhi izikhala phakathi kwamamaki zonke zilingana. Konke ongakubona okwamanje yiziphetho zesokudla. Isiphetho sesokudla sepensela 가 siphawini 9, futhi isiphetho sesokudla sepensela 나 siphawini 8. Awukazi ukubona iziphetho zesobunxele zamapensela amabili. U-Eunseo wathi, "Isiphetho sika-가 sifinyelela ephawini 9, ngakho 가 ide."
y-m-02-05.prereq.0: Incazelo ye-0 ku-ruler nesikhala esisodwa phakathi kwamamaki
y-m-02-05.prereq.1: Ukuqhathanisa ubude ngamagama njengo-'ude / mfushane / ofanayo'
y-m-02-05.s.s1.prompt: Yini enye odinga ukuyazi ukunquma ukuthi amazwi ka-Eunseo alungile yini?
y-m-02-05.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ipensela eyodwa elele ku-ruler, bese usho ukuthi udinga ukwazi indawo yayo kumaki angaki ukwazi ubude bayo.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi ubude buhluka kanjani uma isiphetho sesobunxele sepensela onesiphetho sesokudla ku-9 singu-0 nalapho singu-7.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.r.a: Ubukhulu akulona ulwazi olusetshenziselwa ukuqhathanisa ubude. Ubude bunqunywa kusukela kuphi kuya kuphi.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.o.b: Zingaki izikhala ezisele kuze kufike esiphethweni se-ruler (uphawu 10)
y-m-02-05.s.s1.r.b: Usevele wazi uphawu lwesiphetho sesokudla, ngakho lokhu kuphinda ulwazi olufanayo. Bheka ukuthi likutshela okuthile okusha yini.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.o.c: Isiphetho sesobunxele sepensela ngayinye kwezimbili siphawini luphi
y-m-02-05.s.s1.r.c: Ubone ukuthi udinga kokubili lapho ipensela iqala khona nalapho iphela khona.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.o.d: Iyiphi pensela kwezimbili elibukhali kakhulu ekuhlabeni
y-m-02-05.s.s1.r.d: Udinga ukubheka lapho ipensela ibekwe khona, hhayi indlela eyaliwe. Cabanga ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi oludingekayo uma ufunda ubude emamakini.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.explain: Ubude busuka endaweni lapho ipensela iqala khona kuya lapho iphela khona. Uphawu lwesiphetho sesokudla lodwa alukwazi ukunquma ukuthi iyiphi pensela ende; udinga ukwazi ukuthi isiphetho sesobunxele siphawini luphi.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.prompt: Manje iziphetho zesobunxele ziyaziwa. 가 iqala ephawini 5 no-나 iqala ephawini 0. U-Seohyeon wacabanga futhi ngalolu lwazi. Khetha umugqa emazwini ka-Seohyeon onzima ukuwethemba.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.hint.0: Khomba ngomunwe wakho amamaki kusukela kuphi kuya kuphi lapho 가 no-나 zilele khona ngayinye, bese ubala izikhala.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi ipensela enophawu lokugcina olukhulu nayo iqale endaweni efanayo yini.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.line.0: 가 ilele kusuka ephawini 5 kuya ephawini 9.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.line.1: 나 ilele kusuka ephawini 0 kuya ephawini 8.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.explain: Imigqa 3 no-4 inzima ukuwethemba. Imigqa 1 no-2 ifunde amamaki ngokunembile. 가 isuka ephawini 5 iya ku-9, ngakho izikhala ezingu-4, futhi 나 isuka ephawini 0 iya ku-8, ngakho izikhala ezingu-8. Umugqa 3, oqhathanise kuphela amamaki okugcina, ushaye indawo lapho beqala khona, ngakho nesiphetho somugqa 4 asikwazi ukwethenjwa. Ngolwazi osanda kuluthola, isinqumo sokuqala sika-Eunseo kufanele silungiswe.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.prompt: Noma ngaphandle kwe-ruler, ungazibeka kanjani amapensela amabili ukuqhathanisa ubude bawo ngokuthembekile? Khetha zonke izindlela ezifanele.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi kwenzekani uma ubeka amapensela amabili eceleni komunye nomunye nesiphetho esisodwa siqonde ekhoneni letafula.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.hint.1: Uma isiphetho esisodwa silugwini olufanayo, sho ukuthi kufanele ubheke kuphi esiphethweni esisele ukuqhathanisa ubude.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.o.a: Beka iziphetho zesobunxele zamapensela amabili emgqeni ofanayo bese ubheka iziphetho zesokudla
y-m-02-05.s.s3.r.a: Lo mbono wukuthi uma usulungisile isiphetho esisodwa, udinga kuphela ukuqhathanisa indawo yesiphetho esisele.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.o.b: Beka iziphetho zesokudla zamapensela amabili emgqeni ofanayo bese ubheka iziphetho zesobunxele
y-m-02-05.s.s3.r.b: Lo mbono wukuthi ungalungisa noma yisiphi isiphetho.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.o.c: Beka amapensela amabili kude komunye nomunye bese ubheka ngamehlo
y-m-02-05.s.s3.r.c: Kubonwa kude, abukeka ehlukile kuye ngalapho ebekwe khona nokuphakama kwamehlo akho. Cabanga ukuthi lokho kufana nokuwabeka eceleni komunye nomunye ukuze uqhathanise yini.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.o.d: Sho ukuthi ipensela enesiphetho sesokudla esiphumela ngaphambili ide, nje nje
y-m-02-05.s.s3.r.d: Udlulisele, njengoba linjalo, iphutha lokubheka isiphetho sesokudla kuphela elibonwa enkingeni ye-ruler.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.explain: Uma ulungisa isiphetho esisodwa emgqeni ofanayo, ipensela enesiphetho esisele esiphumela ngaphambili ide. Akunandaba ukuthi ulungisa muphi isiphetho. Ukubeka kude noma ukubheka isiphetho esisodwa kuphela akulona uqhathaniso olwethembekile.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.acc.0: Indlela yokulungisa iziphetho zesobunxele iyathembeka. Kuhle nokwazi ukuthi ukulungisa iziphetho zesokudla kwenza uqhathaniso olufanayo.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.acc.1: Indlela yokulungisa iziphetho zesokudla nayo iyathembeka. Kuhle nokwazi ukuthi ukulungisa iziphetho zesobunxele kwenza uqhathaniso olufanayo.

y-m-02-01.title: Amakhadi amade noma ayekeleziwe nawo angama-quadrilateral?
y-m-02-01.goal: Thola umugqa ophosile embonweni othatha i-quadrilateral ngokuncane njengo-'ime mpo enezinhlangothi ezine zobude obufanayo', beka indinganiso yokwahlulela ngenani lemigqa eqondile nezinhlangothi ezibukhali, futhi uchaze ama-quadrilateral amade noma ayekeleziwe.
y-m-02-01.material: UHarin uqoqe amakhadi amathathu e-quadrilateral. Ikhadi 가 limi mpo futhi yonke imigqa emi-4 eqondile inobude obufanayo. ikhadi 나 lide ngokuvundlile, ngakho imigqa engenhla nengezansi mide futhi imigqa emibili engasohlangothini mifushane. Ikhadi 다 linomumo ofanayo no-가 kodwa liyekelezile ukuze ikhona elibukhali libe phezulu. Wonke amakhadi amathathu azungezwe yimigqa eqondile emi-4 futhi anamakhona abukhali angu-4. (Asikho isithombe, ngakho ucabange ngamazwi.) UHarin wacabanga kanje.
y-m-02-01.thinking.0: Hlola ukuthi umugqa ngamunye wesixazululo unesizathu yini
y-m-02-01.thinking.1: Khetha indinganiso yokwahlulela futhi uhlole ngaleyo ndinganiso
y-m-02-01.thinking.2: Yenza futhi uchaze, ngamazwi, isibonelo somumo omunye ofanelana nendinganiso
y-m-02-01.prereq.0: Ungabona imiumbo yonxantathu, i-quadrilateral, nendilinga futhi usho amagama ayo.
y-m-02-01.prereq.1: Ungabala 'imigqa eqondile' no-'makhona abukhali' ngokukhomba ngomunwe. (Ukubala izinombolo kuze kufike ku-4)
y-m-02-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa emcabangweni kaHarin onzima ukuwuthemba. (Imigqa emibili ingaba nzima ukuyethemba.)
y-m-02-01.s.s1.hint.0: Emakhadini amathathu, khomba ngomunwe futhi ubale ukuthi mingaki imigqa eqondile futhi mingaki amakhona abukhali.
y-m-02-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kumugqa ngamunye, hlukanisa ukuthi isizathu esanikezwa uHarin siyinto 'ebaliwe' noma 'umuzwa osuka ekubukeni kwayo'.
y-m-02-01.s.s1.line.0: Ikhadi 가 linemigqa eqondile emi-4 namakhona abukhali angu-4, ngakho liyi-quadrilateral.
y-m-02-01.s.s1.line.1: Ikhadi 나 lide ngokuvundlile, ngakho aliyona i-quadrilateral.
y-m-02-01.s.s1.line.2: Ikhadi 다 liyekelezile, kodwa linemigqa eqondile emi-4 namakhona abukhali angu-4.
y-m-02-01.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho i-quadrilateral kumele ibe nemigqa eqondile emi-4 yonke yobude obufanayo.
y-m-02-01.s.s1.explain: Imigqa 2 no-4 inzima ukuyethemba. Imigqa 1 no-3 yashiwo ngokubala imigqa eqondile namakhona abukhali. Umugqa 2 unqunywe ngokubheka kuphela u-'lude', futhi umugqa 4 welule lokho okubonwe ekhadini 가 kuphela waba u-'kumele zonke zibe nobude obufanayo'. Noma lide noma liyekelezile, imigqa eqondile emi-4 namakhona abukhali angu-4 kuhlala kunjalo.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.prompt: Uma unquma ukuthi ikhadi 나 liyi-quadrilateral noma cha, yini ethembeke kakhulu ukuyibheka?
y-m-02-01.s.s2.hint.0: Funa lokho okungashintshi noma ujikisa ikhadi 나 noma uliqhubela ngobukhulu.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sho ukuthi yini efanayo nokuthi yini ehlukile phakathi kwamakhadi 가, 나, no-다.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.o.a: Bheka ukuthi linosayizi ofanayo nekhadi lokuqala le-quadrilateral olibonile yini
y-m-02-01.s.s2.r.a: Usayizi akusona isinyathelo sokunquma igama lomumo. I-quadrilateral enkulu ne-quadrilateral encane zombili ziyi-quadrilateral.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.o.b: Bheka ukuthi isiqondiso ikhadi elibekwe ngaso silungile yini
y-m-02-01.s.s2.r.b: Umumo uhlala unjalo noma uwujikisa. Isiqondiso ebekwe ngaso asinakho ukuhlobana negama lomumo.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.o.c: Linganisa ukuthi yonke imigqa eqondile inobude obufanayo yini
y-m-02-01.s.s2.r.c: Usebenzise isici esibonwe ekhadini 가 kuphela njengendinganiso. Hlola ukuthi sisebenza yini njengendinganiso engashiyi ikhadi 나 elide elincane.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.o.d: Bala ukuthi mingaki imigqa eqondile futhi mingaki amakhona abukhali
y-m-02-01.s.s2.r.d: Ubale into engasetshenziselwa ukunquma igama lomumo. Iyinkomba engashintshi noma umumo ude futhi mncane noma uyekelezile.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.explain: Ukuthi mingaki imigqa eqondile nokuthi mingaki amakhona abukhali kuyizinkomba ezingashintshi noma wenza umumo omkhulu noma uwujikisa. Usayizi, isiqondiso ebekwe ngaso, nokuthi ubude bufanayo yini akunakusetshenziswa njengendinganiso yokunquma igama lomumo.
y-m-02-01.s.s3.prompt: Bhala lokho obuyokusho kuHarin. Chaza ngamazwi ikhadi elilodwa elibukeka lihlukile ku-가 kodwa liyi-quadrilateral (isibonelo, lide kangakanani, libekwe kanjani), futhi ubhale isizathu sokuthi kungani lingabizwa ngokuthi i-quadrilateral.
y-m-02-01.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga ukulule ikhadi 가 lide kakhulu noma ulilalise ngohlangothi.
y-m-02-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bala ukuthi lelo khadi linemigqa eqondile emingaki namakhona abukhali amangaki, futhi ufake lezo zinombolo esizathini sakho.
y-m-02-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Kucacile ukuthi ikhadi olichaze ngamazwi lihluke kanjani ku-가?
y-m-02-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Unikeze, njengesizathu, ukuthi lelo khadi linemigqa eqondile emingaki namakhona abukhali amangaki?
y-m-02-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ucabange ukuthi kungani u-'ubude kumele bufane' kungadingeki?
y-m-02-01.s.s3.model.0: Harin, ikhadi elide kakhulu nalo liyi-quadrilateral. Linemigqa eqondile emi-4 namakhona abukhali angu-4. Noma lide, lokho kuhlala kunjalo.
y-m-02-01.s.s3.model.1: Ikhadi eliyi-가 elilele ngohlangothi noma eliyekelezile nalo liyi-quadrilateral. Noma ulijikisa, kusenemigqa eqondile emi-4 namakhona abukhali angu-4.
y-m-02-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Isibonelo esishintsha isiqondiso ebekwe ngaso ngaphandle kokwenza umumo omusha. Lokhu nako kuvumelekile.

y-m-02-02.title: Ingabe okukhulu kunzima? Ukukuphakamisa nokukuphindaphinda
y-m-02-02.goal: Bona ukuthi umbono othi 'okukhulu kunzima' ulungile nini nokuthi awulungile nini, qhubeka ulungisa isahlulelo sakho isikhathi ngasinye lapho kuvela ulwazi olusha, futhi wenze ipheya elilingana ngosayizi kodwa elibonakala lihlukile ngesisindo.
y-m-02-02.material: UJiho wathi, "Okukhulu kunzima." Uthisha wathi ake sihlole amazwi kaJiho. Ubonisa izinto ezimbili ngesikhathi, uziphakamisa ngezandla zombili, futhi ekugcineni uhlola ngokuzibeka esikalini sokulinganisa. (Esikalini sokulinganisa, uhlangothi olunzima luyehla.)
y-m-02-02.thinking.0: Nquma ukuthi ushintsha noma ugcina isahlulelo sakho ngolwazi olusha
y-m-02-02.thinking.1: Hlukanisa amacala lapho kulungile namacala lapho kungalungile
y-m-02-02.prereq.0: Isipiliyoni sokuphakamisa izinto ezimbili ngezandla zombili nokusho ukunzima/ukulula
y-m-02-02.prereq.1: Ukwazi ukuthi esikalini sokulinganisa (i-seesaw), uhlangothi oluyehlayo lunzima.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.prompt: Isikhathi ngasinye lapho kuvela ucezu lolwazi olusha, cabanga ukuthi uhlangothi luni oluzoba nzima. Uma kuvela ulwazi olusha, kulungile ukugcina umcabango wakho noma ukuwushintsha.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.hint.0: Bheka ucezu ngalunye lolwazi futhi qala ngokusho into eyodwa efanayo neyodwa ehlukile kupheya lokugcina.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sho ukuthi iyiphi iphuzu kulolu lwazi impendulo oyikhethile esekelwe kulo.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Ipheya lokuqala: amatshe amabili ohlobo olufanayo. Elilodwa likhulu njengenqindi futhi elilodwa lincane njengochestnut.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Uhlangothi luni ocabanga ukuthi luzoba nzima?
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Uma ayisitshe esifanayo, kulungile kokubili ukuqagela ukuthi itshe elikhulu linzima nokusho ukuthi uzonquma ngemuva kokuliphakamisa. Kulelipheya, u-'okukhulu kunzima' kuyafaneleka.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Lokhu kusebenzise umbono wokuthi uma kuyohlobo olufanayo, okukhulu kunempahla eningi ngaphakathi.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Asikabi khona umkhondo wokucabanga ukuthi elincane linzima. Khumbula ukuthi yimuphi umkhondo owenze ucabange kanjalo.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lo mbono onakekelayo ofuna ukuhlola kuqala. Cabanga nangokuthi mingaki imikhondo.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Uma liphakanyiswa ngezandla zombili, isandla esibambe itshe elikhulu saya ngezansi kakhulu. Ipheya lesibili liwuhlobo olwehlukile. Elilodwa liyibhola lesiponji elikhulu njengezandla ezimbili (liminyana ngokushesha uma ulicindezela), futhi elilodwa liyi-steel marble encane njengenzipho yomunwe omkhulu.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kulokhu, uhlangothi luni ocabanga ukuthi luzoba nzima?
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Ngoba nje ipheya lokuqala lalilungile, awukwazi ukusebenzisa umbono ofanayo kulelipheya. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi impahla ihlukile. Kokubili ukuqagela ukuthi i-steel marble ibonakala inzima nokusho ukuthi kunzima ukunquma ngosayizi kuphela kuyafaneleka.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uthuthele umbono owawulungile kupheya lokuqala njengoba unjalo. Kulelipheya, qala uhlole ukuthi impahla iyafana yini.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Usebenzise umehluko wempahla (isiponji esingacindezelwa nensimbi eqinile) njengomkhondo.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Impahla ihlukile, ngakho kunzima ukunquma ngosayizi kuphela
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ubone ukuthi kudingeka umkhondo ngaphandle kosayizi. Cabanga nangokuthi wenzani ukuze uhlole.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Uma kubekwe esikalini sokulinganisa, uhlangothi olune-steel marble encane lwehle. Uhlangothi olunebhola lesiponji elikhulu lwenyuka.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kungaba yindlela enhle yini yokulungisa amazwi kaJiho "Okukhulu kunzima"?
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Kuyasiza phakathi kwezinto zohlobo olufanayo, kodwa lapho izinhlobo zihlukile, usayizi odwa awukwazi ukunquma isisindo. Ngakho u-'njalo' unamandla ngokweqile, futhi noma uqagela ngosayizi, kwethenjelwa kakhulu ukuhlola ngokuphakamisa noma ngokusebenzisa isikali.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Akunjalo njalo. Lapho kwakuwuhlobo olufanayo, okukhulu kwakunzima, kodwa lapho izinhlobo zihlukile kuhlukile.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ngihlukanise ematsheni amabili nasemapheya amabili esiponji ne-steel marble futhi ngasho.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Welule umphumela wepheya elilodwa wawenza wasebenza kuwo wonke amacala. Khumbula futhi ukuthi amatshe epheya lokuqala ayenjani.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: UJiho uyalungile. Ibhola lesiponji likhulu, ngakho isikali siphosile.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Lapho okulindelwe nomphumela kwahluka, wangabaza umphumela. Bheka futhi kanye ukuthi uhloliswe ngani ngesikali.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ungaqondi ngosayizi; kufanele uhlole ngokuphakamisa noma ngokubeka esikalini.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ukhethe indlela yokuhlola ngqo kunokuhamba ngosayizi.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.reflect: Epheya lokuqala, umbono othi 'itshe elikhulu linzima' wawuyisahlulelo esingagcinwa, futhi epheya lesibili, ulwazi olusha lokuthi impahla iyashintsha lwasho ukuthi lowo mbono wawungasasetshenziswa njengoba unjalo. Okubalulekile kule msebenzi ukusho ukuthi umbono wakho ulungile kuze kufike kuluphi ulwazi ngokufaka izimo.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ipheya elilodwa lezinto ezimbili ezibukeka zifana ngosayizi kodwa ezibonakala zihluka kakhulu ngesisindo. Futhi ubhale ukuthi wawuzohlola kanjani.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ngezinto ezimbili ekilasini lakho noma ekhaya futhi uqale ngokuqhathanisa osayizi bazo.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ubuzozwa kanjani uma ubamba lezo zinto ezimbili, eyodwa esandleni ngasinye, nokuthi hlangothi luni olwehlayo uma uzibeka esikalini.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Izinto ezimbili owazikhethile zifana ngempela ngosayizi?
y-m-02-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Unqume ukuthi ucabanga ukuthi iyiphi kuzinto ezimbili enzima?
y-m-02-02.s.s2.model.0: Ibhola likakhotini nelitshana bafana ngosayizi, kodwa ngicabanga ukuthi itshana linzima. Ngingahlola ngokubamba eyodwa esandleni ngasinye noma ngokuzibeka esikalini sokulinganisa.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.model.1: Ibhokisi elingenalutho nebhokisi elinezincwadi ngaphakathi linosayizi ofanayo, kodwa ibhokisi elinezincwadi linzima. Uma ngizibeka ku-seesaw, ngingabona ukuthi uhlangothi luni olwehlayo.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Isibonelo lapho okungaphakathi kwento eyodwa kuhlukile nakho kuvumelekile.

y-m-02-04.title: Ingabe inkomishi ende ibamba amanzi amaningi?
y-m-02-04.goal: Khetha izindlela ezithembekile zokuhlola umbono othi 'uma ide, ibamba okuningi', hlulela ngomphumela wokuthela kusuka kokukodwa uye kolunye, bese wenza ngamagama isimo senkomishi lapho lo mbono uphutha khona.
y-m-02-04.material: Inkomishi 가 inkomishi ende kakhulu futhi emincane. Inkomishi 나 inkomishi emfushane futhi ibanzi kakhulu. Zombili izinkomishi zivulekile phezulu futhi zibushelelezi ngaphakathi. U-Ain wathi, "가 ide, ngakho 가 ibamba amanzi amaningi." U-Junho wathi, "Ake singahlulele ngalokho esikubonayo, ake sihlole ngamanzi."
y-m-02-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izindlela zokuthola ngokuthembekile ukuthi yiyiphi inkomishi ebamba amanzi amaningi.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ngaphandle kokubheka ngamehlo, cabanga indlela yokuqhathanisa izinkomishi ezimbili ngamanzi angempela.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.hint.1: Sho ngamagama, ngayinye, ukuthi indlela ngayinye ikala noma iqhathanisa ini ngempela, bese uhlola ukuthi lokho kufana nenani lamanzi elibambayo yini.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.o.a: Beka izinkomishi ezimbili eceleni komunye nomunye bese ubheka ukuphakama kuphela
y-m-02-04.s.s1.r.a: Ukuphakama kuyinkomba eyodwa nje. Awukwazi ukusho ukuthi inkomishi ibanzi kangakanani.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.o.b: Thela amanzi agcwalisa inkomishi 가 aze afike phezulu enkomisheni 나 bese ubheka
y-m-02-04.s.s1.r.b: Le yindlela yokuthela amanzi ngqo ukuqhathanisa osayizi benkomishi ezimbili. Cabanga nokuthi ungawufunda kanjani umphumela.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.o.c: Zisuse ngezandla zakho bese ukhetha inkomishi esindayo
y-m-02-04.s.s1.r.c: Ubuzokala inkomishi ngokwayo. Cabanga ukuthi lokho kufana nenani lamanzi elibambayo yini.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.o.d: Bala ukuthi uyigcwalisa kangaki ngesitsha esincane esifanayo
y-m-02-04.s.s1.r.d: Le yindlela esebenzisa isitsha esifanayo njengeyunithi futhi iqhathanisa izinkomishi ezimbili ngesilinganiso esifanayo.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.explain: Uma uthela amanzi ngqo noma ubala inani lezikhathi ozigcwalisa ngazo ngesitsha esifanayo, ungaqhathanisa inani lamanzi izinkomishi ezilibambayo, noma ngabe ziyiphi isimo. Ukubheka ukuphakama kuphela noma ukuphakamisa izinkomishi ezingenalutho akuqhathanisi ngqo inani lamanzi elibambayo.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.acc.0: Ukuthela kuphela kunganikeza umphumela othembekile. Kuhle nokwazi ukuthi kunendlela yokubala ngesitsha esifanayo.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.acc.1: Indlela yokubala izikhathi ngesitsha esincane esifanayo nayo iyathembeka. Kuhle nokwazi ukuthi kunendlela yokuthela.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.prompt: U-Junho wagcwalisa inkomishi 가 ngamanzi wawathela wonke enkomisheni 나 ngaphandle kokuchitha ithonsi, futhi amanzi enkomisheni 나 agcwalisa cishe uhhafu wenkomishi kuphela. Yini engasho kusukela kulo mphumela?
y-m-02-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ngamagama kokubili ukuthi amanzi enkomisheni 가 ayeyinani eligcwele nokuthi inkomishi 나 ayizange igcwaliswe yilawo manzi.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ngemva kokuthela onke amanzi enkomisheni 가, dweba isithombe sokuthi inkomishi 나 igcwale kuze kufike ngakuphi nokuthi kusele indawo engenalutho yini.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.r.a: Ufunde ukuthi amanzi athelwe awazange agcwalise inkomishi, futhi waqhathanisa osayizi bezinkomishi ezimbili.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.r.b: Ubeke umcabango wokuqala wokuthi ide phambi komphumela. Cabanga ukuthi kusho ini ukuthi wonke amanzi ka-가 ahanjiswe futhi 나 ayigcwele.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.o.c: Izinkomishi ezimbili zibamba inani elifanayo lamanzi
y-m-02-04.s.s2.r.c: Bheka ukuthi amanzi agcwalisa inkomishi agcwalise inkomishi 나 yini.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.r.d: Ukuhlola kanye futhi kuyisaga esihle. Kodwa uma onke amanzi ahanjiswe ngaphandle kokuchitheka, bheka ukuthi kukhona okuthile lo mphumela wodwa ukuvumela ukuthi ukusho yini.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.explain: Amanzi agcwalisa inkomishi 가 agcwalise cishe uhhafu wenkomishi 나 kuphela, ngakho inkomishi 나 ingabamba amanzi amaningi kunalawo. Umbono wokuqala (uma ide, ibamba okuningi) wawungalungile kule pheya yezinkomishi.
y-m-02-04.s.s3.prompt: Chaza ngamagama izinkomishi ezimbili ezintsha (inkomishi 다 nenkomishi 라) lapho umbono ka-Ain othi "uma ide, ibamba amanzi amaningi" ungase ungalungile khona. Kufanele zibe yizinkomishi ezihlukile ku-가 no-나; bhala ukuphakama nobubanzi benkomishi ezimbili ngezinombolo noma ngamagama (isb. ukuphakama 20 cm, ububanzi 3 cm), futhi ubhale nokuthi iyiphi inkomishi ebamba amanzi amaningi.
y-m-02-04.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga izinkomishi ezimbili ngokukhetha izinombolo ezihlukile ku-가 no-나 (ukuphakama nge-cm, ububanzi nge-cm). Funa lokho okunye okuhlukile ngaphandle kokuphakama.
y-m-02-04.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukugcwalisa zombili izinkomishi ngamanzi kuze kufike ekuphakameni okufanayo bese uqhathanisa ukuthi uhlangothi luni lubamba amanzi amaningi.
y-m-02-04.s.s3.placeholder: isb. Inkomishi 다 ... futhi inkomishi 라 ...
y-m-02-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Enkomisheni 다 nenkomishi 라 oyidwebile, ingabe kucacile ukuthi iyiphi ende neyiphi ebanzi?
y-m-02-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe yaphuma ingesimo lapho inkomishi emfushane, hhayi ende, ibamba amanzi amaningi?
y-m-02-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe wakwazi ukuhlola ukuthi amazwi ami alungile yini ngokuthela noma ngokubala ngesitsha esifanayo?
y-m-02-04.s.s3.model.0: Inkomishi 다 ide ngo-20 cm kodwa icasuka kakhulu, futhi inkomishi 라 imfushane ngo-8 cm kodwa ibanzi kakhulu. Inkomishi 라 emfushane nebanzi ibamba amanzi amaningi.
y-m-02-04.s.s3.model.1: Inkomishi 다 ide kodwa icasuka ngo-3 cm ububanzi, futhi inkomishi 라 ide ngo-10 cm futhi eqinile ngo-12 cm ububanzi. Inkomishi 라 ingabamba okuningi. Ungathola ngokuthela amanzi ka-다 ku-라.
y-m-02-04.s.s3.model.2: Inkomishi 다 ide kakhulu futhi icasuka, futhi inkomishi 라 imfushane futhi ibanzi kakhulu. Amanzi amaningi angena enkomisheni 라 kunasenkomisheni ende 다.

y-m-02-06.title: Ukuhlobisa iphosta ngezingcezu ezi-8: yiziphi izindlela ezingenzeka?
y-m-02-06.goal: Yenza hhayi kunye kodwa ukuhlangana okuningana kwamanani ezingcezu zezimo ogcina izimo eziningana ngasikhathi sinye, bese uqhathanisa izindlela zokuzithola ngaphandle kokushiya.
y-m-02-06.material: Ikilasi luka-Saerom lihlobisa iphosta ngezingcezu ezimise okukanxantathu, okwe-quadrilateral, nokwesiyingi. Sekuyonke, kufanele kunamathiselwe izingcezu ezi-8. Kunezimo ezintathu. ① Sebenzisa okungenani okukodwa ngalunye kwezingcezu zonxantathu, ze-quadrilateral, nezesiyingi. ② Sebenzisa izingcezu ze-quadrilateral ezimbalwa kunezingcezu zonxantathu. ③ Kunezingcezu ezi-8 sekuyonke. (Akukho sithombe, ngakho cabanga kuphela ngenani lezingcezu.)
y-m-02-06.thinking.1: Ukuthola izixazululo ezihlukile ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanayo
y-m-02-06.thinking.2: Ukuhlola izindlela zokuthola ngaphandle kokushiya lutho
y-m-02-06.prereq.0: Ukwazi izimo zonxantathu, zezinhlangothi ezine nezindingilizi

y-m-02-06.prereq.2: Ukubhanqa izinombolo kuze kufike ku-10 (isibonelo, amabhanqa ahlukanisa u-8 abe ngamabili)
y-m-02-06.s.s1.prompt: Abangani abane banqume amanani ezicucu. Khetha amaplani angagcini izimo. (Kungaba khona amabili noma ngaphezulu.)
y-m-02-06.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola izimo ezintathu ngasinye ngesikhathi kuplani ngalinye. Qala ubale zonke izicucu ubone ukuthi zingu-8 yini.
y-m-02-06.s.s1.hint.1: Bese ubeka amanani ezicucu zezinhlangothi ezine nezonxantathu eceleni komunye nomunye uqhathanise ukuthi yiziphi ezimbalwa.

y-m-02-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Usebenzise okungenani ucezu olulodwa lwazo zonke izimo ezintathu.
y-m-02-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Kumele usebenzise okungenani oyedwa wonxantathu, wezinhlangothi ezine, nowendingilizi.
y-m-02-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Kunezicucu zezinhlangothi ezine ezimbalwa kunezicucu zonxantathu.
y-m-02-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Azimbalwa izicucu zezinhlangothi ezine kunezicucu zonxantathu.
y-m-02-06.s.s2.fail.c4: Azingu-8 izicucu sekukonke. Bala zonke izinombolo ezintathu.
y-m-02-06.s.s2.explain: Kunamabhanqa angu-9 amanani ezicucu sekukonke agcina izimo. Ukuthola elilodwa kuphela kuyanela, kodwa kubalulekile ukuhlola ukuthi kunamabhanqa amaningana ahlukene.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.prompt: Ungawathola kanjani wonke amabhanqa angenzeka amanani ezicucu ngaphandle kokushiya lutho? Khetha zonke izindlela ezifanele.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.hint.0: Hlela amabhanqa owathole ethebuleni, bese uwahlukanisa ukuze umugqa owodwa ube nezinhlangothi ezine ezingu-1, olandelayo ube nezingu-2, njalo njalo.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.hint.1: Uma kunocezu olungu-1 lwezinhlangothi ezine, hlola ngakunye ukuthi onxantathu bangaba bangakanani, kusukela kunani elincane kuya kunani elikhulu.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.o.a: Bafune njengoba bezofika emqondweni bese uma lapho kungasafiki lutho emqondweni
y-m-02-06.s.s3.r.a: Ayikho indlela yokuhlola ukuthi kushiyiwe yini okuthile. Cabanga ukuthi ungazi kanjani ukuthi amabhanqa owathole wonke.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.o.b: Misa inani lezicucu zezinhlangothi ezine ngalinye bese uhlukanisa okusele
y-m-02-06.s.s3.r.b: Lena yindlela yokumisa into eyodwa bese ushintsha okusele ngokulandelana.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.o.c: Thola indlela eyodwa kuphela esebenzisa onxantathu abaningi kakhulu
y-m-02-06.s.s3.r.c: Ucabange ukuthi usuqedile uma uthola isibonelo esisodwa. Lomsebenzi ukhuluma ngokubheka ukuthi kukhona yini okuningi okungenzeka.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.o.d: Misa inani lezicucu zezindingilizi ngalinye bese uhlukanisa okusele
y-m-02-06.s.s3.r.d: Lena yindlela yokumisa enye bese ushintsha okusele ngokulandelana. Cabanga ukuthi ungawathola wonke ngaphandle kwezikhala noma ngabe umisa muphi umumo.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.explain: Uma umisa inani lomumo owodwa bese ushintsha okusele ngakunye, ungakhuluma ukuthi ususeqe kangakanani, ngakho ungawathola ngaphandle kokushiya lutho. Uma ubheka njengoba kufika emqondweni noma umise kokukodwa, awukwazi ukwazi ukuthi ibhanqa lishiyiwe yini.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.acc.0: Indlela yokumisa inani lezicucu zezinhlangothi ezine iyindlela yokuthola ngaphandle kokushiya lutho. Indlela yokumisa izindingilizi iyafana.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.acc.1: Indlela yokumisa inani lezicucu zezindingilizi nayo iyindlela yokuthola ngaphandle kokushiya lutho. Indlela yokumisa izinhlangothi ezine iyafana.
